title: Get what you pay for, but the pics are very misleading
text: Get what you pay for, but the pics are very misleading. "Super heavy duty"???  What product did that reviewer buy?  These things are cheap, cheap, cheap, thin, thin, thin, small, small, small.... but.......................... at a buck and some cents a hanger, what did I expect realistically?  Not returning, not worth it.  Yes you can close your door with these things.  But understand these things are small.  You need to be a tall person to reach the top of the door to put your towel on it, and don't make it a big towel okay?
